summary_en: 350,000 shares (1.5% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) to be acquired on Tokyo Stock Exchange at market prices, aggregate limit ¥500M, from Jun 12 to Nov 30, 2026. CEO also continuing personal share purchases via employee stock-ownership plan initiated Jul 2024, committing to open-market acquisition above annual compensation level.
title_en: Notice of Decision on Matters Relating to Treasury Stock Acquisition and Continuing Share Acquisition by Representative Director and CEO through Employee Stock Ownership Plan
translation_en_brief:
On 11 June 2026, Bengo4.com's board of directors authorized a treasury stock acquisition programme under Article 459 para. 1 of the Companies Act. The company will acquire up to 350,000 shares (1.5% of shares outstanding excluding treasury, which numbered 22,867,600 as of 31 March 2026) for an aggregate amount not exceeding ¥500 million via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 12 June and 30 November 2026. The company states that its current share price is significantly undervalued relative to strong business performance and future growth prospects, and that treasury acquisition represents the most certain and highest-return-efficiency investment opportunity available.

The disclosure also announces that CEO and Representative Director Motoe Taichiro has been acquiring shares on a personal basis through an employee stock-ownership plan (役員持株会) established in July 2024. Since inception, Motoe has continuously purchased shares in amounts exceeding his annual compensation (including variable remuneration) over the two-year period, demonstrating long-term commitment to enterprise value creation. Motoe states he will continue this personal acquisition programme going forward.
